很多人在平台上发帖，最大的问题不是没人需要，而是别人看不懂、看不放心，或者看完还: A post often struggles not because nobody needs it, but because people can't understand it, don't feel confident, or still need to ask a dozen questions. When posting housing, services, or used items on BayLink, the goal isn't to sound like an ad. Make it clear who you are, what you offer, and who it's for. Put contact hours in the post, and specific phone, WeChat, or email details in Contact Settings so they can be shared through in-app requests according to your preferences.
先把别人最关心的信息写前面: Put the details people care about most first
房源：区域、房型、租金、入住时间、是否合租、是否有车位。: Housing: area, home type, rent, move-in date, whether it's shared, and parking availability.
服务：服务内容、覆盖区域、可上门时间、报价方式和方便沟通的时段。: Services: what you do, coverage area, available visit times, pricing method, and convenient contact hours.
二手：物品名称、成色、尺寸、价格、提货方式。: Secondhand: item name, condition, dimensions, price, and pickup method.
“价格美丽”“诚心出”“靠谱服务”“欢迎咨询”这些都可以有，但必须建立在信息已经: Phrases like "great price," "serious seller," "reliable service," and "inquiries welcome" are fine, but the details must already be clear. Give a numerical range when possible, specify time windows, and state restrictions upfront.
房间长什么样、家具在不在、服务做什么、车是什么类型，能拍清楚就拍清楚。照片和文字: Show what the room looks like, whether furniture is included, what the service does, or the vehicle type as clearly as possible. Photos that don't match the description undermine trust.
用和内容不匹配的旧图、样板图、网图，短期可能吸引点击，长期反而更容易被跳过、被质: Unrelated old photos, showroom images, or pictures found online may get clicks briefly, but can make people skip, question, or report the post later.
把“适合谁”写出来，会更容易被联系: Say who it's for to make it easier for the right people to contact you
房源可写：适合学生、实习生、South Bay 上班族、无车用户、有车用户。: For housing, you might describe suitability for students, interns, South Bay commuters, or people with or without a car.
服务可写：适合小型搬家、同城送件、深度清洁、临时接送。: For services, specify suitability: small moves, local deliveries, deep cleaning, or occasional rides.
二手可写：适合拎包入住、学生过渡、家庭补件。: For used items, specify suitability: move-in essentials, temporary student housing, or replacement household items.
真正让人放心的，是信息完整和边界清楚: Complete information and clear boundaries build confidence
标题是否一眼看懂。: Is the title easy to understand at a glance?
价格或价格范围是否明确。: Is the price or price range clear?
联系时段是否清楚；具体电话、微信、邮箱是否填写在「联系方式设置」中。: Are contact hours clear, and are phone, WeChat, and email details entered in Contact Settings?
是否说明限制条件和注意事项。: Are restrictions and important details explained?
图片是否真实且近期。: Are the images genuine and recent?
发帖前先问自己一句：如果我是陌生人，只看这条内容，会不会还要追问五个最基本的问题: Before posting, ask yourself: if I were a stranger seeing only this post, would I still need to ask five basic questions? If so, the post can probably be clearer.
把信息写清楚，通常比把语气写热闹更有用: Clear information usually helps more than an enthusiastic tone
